subject: Orchard Bank: Vulnerability management evidence & SBOM follow-up
messages:
From: Laura McIntyre <laura.mcintyre@orchardbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchard Bank Security Team <security@orchardbank.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Orchard RFI - vulnerability management clarifications (ORCH-2027-RFI-219)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for your initial submission to our RFI. The security review team had a few follow-ups specifically around vulnerability management and SBOM coverage before we progress to procurement:

1) Can you provide the last 12 months of SAST and DAST summary reports (high/critical findings only) and remediation timelines for each?
2) Please confirm your patch SLA definitions by severity and your measured median time-to-patch over the last year.
3) Do you have a recent third-party pen test report and an executive summary we can share with our risk committee?
4) We require an SBOM in SPDX or CycloneDX format that includes transitive dependencies and license metadata.
5) Describe your CVE intake and customer notification process (timelines and evidence).

I've attached the RFI questionnaire we use (orchard_vuln_questionnaire.xlsx) — feel free to reference the row IDs in your response. Our deadline to include evidence in the initial evaluation packet is Feb 22 COB.

Would appreciate confirmation you can deliver the artifacts by then. If helpful, we can book a 30-minute sync.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura McIntyre
Senior Information Security Manager
Orchard Bank

--- attachment: orchard_vuln_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Orchard RFI - vulnerability management clarifications (ORCH-2027-RFI-219)

Folks — forwarding Orchard's follow-ups. Their deadline is Feb 22 COB. Can you assemble the evidence bundle and draft the cover note? Key asks: SAST/DAST high/critical summaries, measured patch SLAs, pen-test exec summary, and an SBOM export (SPDX preferred).

Neha — can you own the SBOM snapshot and pen-test summary?
Aditya — can you pull the SAST/DAST topline and the time-to-patch metrics; also draft the CVE intake/process blurb.

Let's aim for an internal review by Feb 18 so Vivek can sign off before we send. If anything will slip the deadline, flag now and we'll propose a short call with Orchard.

Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Feb 10, 2027 at 09:12 AM Laura McIntyre <laura.mcintyre@orchardbank.com> wrote: (see below)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 14:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orchard RFI - vulnerability management clarifications (ORCH-2027-RFI-219)

Vivek / Aditya — draft bundle attached. Short summary below and quick answers to each numbered item: 

1) SAST/DAST:
- Attached: 'sast_dast_topline_2026-2027.pdf' inside the zip. Only high/critical findings included, with remediation status.
- Cadence: SAST runs on every mainline PR + weekly full scan; DAST runs every release candidate.

2) Patch SLA:
- Definitions by severity: Critical = 24-72 hours (mitigation/fix depending on vendor patch availability), High = 7 days, Medium = 30 days, Low = 90 days.
- Measured medians (rolling 12mo): Critical = 48 hrs, High = 6 days, Medium = 18 days, Low = 64 days.

3) Pen test:
- Attached: 'rdw_pen_test_summary_q3-2026.pdf' (third-party: Redwood Security Partners). Exec summary and remediation map included.

4) SBOM:
- Attached SPDX snapshot: 'rdw_sbom_snapshot_20270130.spdx' — includes transitive deps and license metadata, generated from our build pipeline. We also provide a machine-readable JSON export in the bundle.

5) CVE intake/customer notification:
- Process: automated CVE ingestion via vendor feeds + manual triage within 48 hours. Customer notification policy: immediate notification for Critical with recommended mitigations; follow-up with patch ETA within 72 hours. The evidence bundle includes the 'cve_handling_playbook.md' (summary).

Attachments in rdw_vm_evidence_bundle_v1.zip: rdw_pen_test_summary_q3-2026.pdf, rdw_sbom_snapshot_20270130.spdx, sast_dast_topline_2026-2027.pdf, cve_handling_playbook.md, SBOM_json_export_20270130.json

I've uploaded the unzipped folder to the shared Drive link below for Orchard reviewers. If they need signed attestation for any artifact, say the word and I will coordinate with Legal.

Neha
Director, Security Assurance
Redwood Inference

From: Laura McIntyre <laura.mcintyre@orchardbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchard Bank Security Team <security@orchardbank.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orchard RFI - vulnerability management clarifications (ORCH-2027-RFI-219)

Thanks for the quick turnaround — we received the Drive folder and I reviewed the topline. A couple of clarifications: 

- Patch SLA: your 'Critical = 24-72 hours' note references vendor patch availability. For our evaluation we need a clear statement of what you commit to for vulnerabilities in Redwood-managed code versus third-party components. Can you provide language that distinguishes the two and any escalation paths for delayed vendor fixes?

- SBOM: Confirm the SPDX includes SHA checksums and license fields for transitive dependencies. Also can you confirm how often you regenerate the SBOM for production images?

- Attestation: Our procurement team will probably request a signed attestation of the pen-test status and the SBOM snapshot date. Is Legal able to provide a short attestation letter?

If you can reply with those clarifications by Feb 24, that will keep us on track. Otherwise, let's set a 20-minute call.

Best,
Laura

--- Orchard Bank Security Team

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura McIntyre <laura.mcintyre@orchardbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 16:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orchard RFI - vulnerability management clarifications (ORCH-2027-RFI-219)

Hi Laura — thanks for the review and the specific asks. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- Vendor vs Redwood-managed code: Redwood commits to patching vulnerabilities in Redwood-owned code per the SLA stated: Critical = remediate or provide mitigations within 24-72 hours; High = 7 days. For third-party dependencies, our policy is to apply vendor fixes as soon as they are available; if vendor fixes are delayed we provide mitigation plans (e.g., configuration changes, temporary controls) within 72 hours and a tracked remediation ETA. I'll attach a one-page distinction statement for procurement.

- SBOM specifics: The SPDX snapshot in the bundle includes package names, versions, SHA256 checksums, and license fields for transitive dependencies. We regenerate production image SBOMs on every release pipeline run; for long-running images we publish a weekly SBOM delta.

- Attestation: Legal can provide a short attestation letter for the pen-test executive summary and the SBOM snapshot date. Neha — can you coordinate with Legal and provide the attestation PDF by Feb 24?

Link to the evidence folder and the HubSpot RFI record are below. If you'd like a brief call to walk through the artifacts, I can schedule 20 minutes early next week.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRDW-VM-Evidence
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ORCH-2027-RFI-219
DocuSign (for any formal attestation): https://www.docusign.net/teamsign/abcde12345

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
